en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a small town in a rural, hilly landscape. Modest one‑ and two‑story houses and farm buildings with pitched roofs fill the foreground, with a tall chimney or smokestack visible to the left. Fields and a winding road extend into the distant hills. Printed caption text at the top reads "Sabile. Zabeln."
